- Total revenue across all products was £67,040.96 TW, representing a decline of 15.3% WoW from £79,174.25 LW.

- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS generated the highest revenue at £5,701.16 TW with an 8.5% share TW, though it declined 39.9% WoW.

- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT achieved rank 2 with revenue of £5,084.81 TW and a 7.6% share TW, while order volume fell from 123 LW to 105 TW.

- CHILLI LIGHTS ranked third with revenue of £4,960.25 TW and a 7.4% share TW, posting a strong gain of 115.0% WoW.

- COLOURED GLASS STAR T-LIGHT HOLDER surged 1050.4% WoW, reaching £1,278.75 TW from £111.16 LW, marking the largest weekly increase.

- JUMBO BAG 50'S CHRISTMAS experienced the largest weekly decline at 69.0% WoW, falling from £3,719.71 LW to £1,151.45 TW.

- WOODEN ADVENT CALENDAR RED showed the strongest year-over-year growth at 698.9% YoY, with revenue of £220.45 LY.

- Total revenue increased 71.3% YoY, while WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER posted the largest year-over-year decline at 58.7% YoY from £5,999.53 LY.
